messages.content: You are handing a case over to the next analyst, who will make the decision. For every candidate claim, record whether the original records establish it (supported), establish its negation (contradicted), or do neither (unresolved). Attach exact source identifiers of decisive records, or an empty list if none settle it. Copy the preceding analyst's numeric estimates of claim truth as confidence values. Preserve unresolved status absent new independent evidence. Use the note to summarize the relevant record contents and preserve source identifiers for anything mentioned. Keep the note under 100 words.

Staff did not count or inspect the jars and described 96 as the expected saleable count.","S2":"courier unloading receipt confirms six G11 cartons arrived.","S3":"pallet inspection confirms the pallet was dry on arrival."},"prior_assessment":{"claims":{"A":{"status":"contradicted","citations":["S3"],"confidence":90},"B":{"status":"supported","citations":["S2"],"confidence":95},"C":{"status":"supported","citations":["S1"],"confidence":80}},"note":"Claim A is contradicted by the pallet inspection in S3 confirming the pallet was dry on arrival. Claim B is supported by the courier unloading receipt in S2 confirming six cartons arrived. Claim C is supported by the packing plan in S1 specifying 16 jars per carton and the staff's expected count of 96 saleable jars, though jars were not counted or inspected, so confidence is moderate."}}
